regime_context: Detector shows a broad, non-dominant commodity-led rotation: Oil & Gas Producers lead with a marginal edge over Gold Miners (margin 0.088), with 8 of 16 themes eligible but no one-narrative structure. The only validated leg is the absolute-trend gate (which has helped drawdown historically here), so momentum rank is treated purely as a focus lens — no return forecast. Track record (n=89) shows decent hit rate but weak directional accuracy (0.371), so conviction is capped low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (challenger, margin 0.088) closes the rotation gap on Oil & Gas Producers over the next 10 sessions — a confirmed crossover in momentum score with Gold Miners taking the rank-1 slot for two consecutive readings would retire this watch and indicate a possible (not predicted) leadership handoff.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is the top-ranked theme by momentum score (1.43) and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with breadth 0.429 and no crowding flag (crowding_z 0.85, crowded=false). It is the current leader in the rotation radar, though the margin over Gold Miners is thin (0.088). The trend-gate is the only validated risk-control leg in this market's history, so an eligible leader with non-crowded texture is the cleanest place to express a directional lean.
evidence: rotation leader with margin 0.088 over Gold Miners
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has ~0 forward edge (rank-IC weak); the thin rotation margin suggests leadership is contested and could hand off quickly. Breadth 0.429 is mediocre — not a broad, cohesive uptrend. The macro backdrop (unscheduled_share 1.0) implies headline-driven chop that can reverse commodity themes suddenly.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO gives back all of its trailing 10-day gain and closes below its 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners ranks 2nd (score 1.342), eligible, non-crowded (crowding_z 0.2), and is the closest challenger in the rotation radar. Its mean-revert hurst_tag suggests the trend may be less persistent than Oil & Gas, but it is in the top eligible cohort and the trend-gate is satisfied. A low-conviction lean on a non-crowded, eligible top-3 theme fits the discipline-not-prediction mandate.
evidence: hurts_tag mean-revert (lower durability than Oil & Gas)
theses.dissent: The mean-revert hurst tag and narrow breadth (0.267) suggest this is a weaker, potentially self-reversing trend than the leader. A challenger at thin margin is not a confirmed handoff — it may simply be noise around the leader.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 5% cumulatively before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only theme with a crowding flag (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.17) and has a negative momentum score (-0.193, rank 8) despite being eligible. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a short — so the lean is expressed as 'avoid' rather than underweight-on-short. Given the validated trend-gate is about avoiding drawdowns, a crowded theme with negative momentum and mixed hurst is the least attractive eligible risk.
evidence: durability_bar 0.70 (highest in set) but hurst_tag mixed
eligible=true so it is a live avoid candidate, not just an ineligible rank
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and the guardrails explicitly forbid treating it as a sell. A crowded theme with high bar breadth (0.7) could continue to run if AI/tech narrative dominates the macro backdrop (ai_tech is a top coincident macro theme).
